verdict.rationale: Ashby publishes a first-party API reference at developers.ashbyhq.com/reference, with per-endpoint pages (candidate.create, application.list, pagination) and markdown versions of those pages. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, a public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: A sync token to retrieve only applications updated since the last sync. Obtained from a previous list response.
Some endpoints are paginated, and, optionally take an opaque "cursor" to indicate the page of results to fetch.
